objective: Al terminar usas relativas con preposición (the book in which…, the person to whom…) y estructuras formales con whom, whose y which para describir obras y personas.

warmup.prompt_es: 'El libro del que te hablé', 'la persona con quien trabajo', 'el museo en el que se expone'. Las relativas con preposición tienen una versión formal (preposición + whom/which) y una informal (preposición al final).

text: The novel, which I read last summer, is set in a small village in which nothing ever happens. The author, about whom very little is known, wrote it under a pseudonym. The main character, to whom the reader quickly becomes attached, is a lonely librarian whose only friend is a stray cat.

The librarian lives in a house in front of which there is an old oak tree, under which she reads every afternoon. The people with whom she works are kind but distant. The one person for whom she feels real affection is an old professor, from whom she borrows rare books.
The moment at which everything changes is a letter, the contents of which are not revealed until the final chapter. The reason for which she keeps the letter secret is the heart of the story.

It is a book of which I'm very fond, and it's one that I would recommend to anyone who enjoys quiet, thoughtful fiction. The editor, whom I met at a festival, told me that the publishers expect it to become a classic.
input.es: La novela, que leí el verano pasado, está ambientada en un pequeño pueblo en el que nunca pasa nada. La autora, de quien se sabe muy poco, la escribió bajo seudónimo. La protagonista, a quien el lector se apega enseguida, es una bibliotecaria solitaria cuya única amiga es una gata callejera. La bibliotecaria vive en una casa frente a la cual hay un viejo roble, bajo el cual lee cada tarde. Las personas con quienes trabaja son amables pero distantes. La única persona por la que siente verdadero afecto es un viejo profesor, a quien pide prestados libros raros. El momento en que todo cambia es una carta, cuyo contenido no se revela hasta el último capítulo. La razón por la que guarda en secreto la carta es el corazón de la historia. Es un libro que me gusta mucho y que recomendaría a cualquiera que disfrute de la ficción tranquila y reflexiva. El editor, a quien conocí en un festival, me dijo que los editores esperan que se convierta en un clásico.

md_es: **Relativas con preposición**
| Registro | Estructura | Ejemplo |
| **Formal** | *preposición + whom / which / whose* | *The person **to whom** I spoke.* · *The book **in which** the story is set.* |
| **Informal** | *who/that/which + … + preposición* | *The person (who) I spoke **to**.* · *The book (that) the story is set **in**.* |
**Pronombres según el referente**
| Referente | Con preposición (formal) |
| persona | *to whom, with whom, for whom, about whom, from whom* |
| cosa | *in which, on which, at which, to which, of which, for which* |
| posesión | *whose + sustantivo* (persona o cosa) · *the contents of which* |
**Reglas**
- Tras preposición: **whom** (persona) y **which** (cosa), **nunca** *who* ni *that*. ✘ *The person to who I spoke.* ✘ *the book in that …*
- **That** no puede ir tras preposición. ✔ *The book that I read.* ✔ *The book in which I found it.*
- En relativas explicativas (con comas), se prefiere la estructura con preposición: *The author, about whom little is known, …*
- *Whose* indica posesión: *the librarian whose only friend is a cat.*
**Expresiones de cantidad + relativo**
- *some of whom / which · many of whom · none of which · the first of which*: *He has three novels, two of which are bestsellers.*
**Where / when / why**
- *the house where she lives* = *the house in which she lives* = *the house (that) she lives in*.
- *the day when / on which they met* · *the reason why / for which she left*.
**Verbos con preposición fija (la preposición va con el verbo)**
- *The man (whom) I was talking to* → formal: *The man to whom I was talking.* · *The film I was looking forward to* → *The film to which I was looking forward.* (muy formal).
**Errores típicos**
- ✘ *The person to who I spoke …* → ✔ *The person to whom I spoke …* / *The person (who) I spoke to …*
- ✘ *The book in that I found it …* → ✔ *The book in which I found it …* / *The book (that) I found it in …*
- ✘ *The house in which I live in …* → ✔ *The house in which I live …* (no repetir la preposición).
- ✘ *The man whose his wife is a doctor …* → ✔ *The man whose wife is a doctor …*
- ✘ *The woman, that I met, is …* (con comas) → ✔ *The woman, whom I met, is …*
**Ojo:** tras *whose* no va artículo. *Whom* se usa casi solo en escritura formal; en conversación se dice *who* o se omite el relativo.
Pronunciación: *whom* /huːm/ · *whose* /huːz/ · *pseudonym* /ˈsjuːdənɪm/ · *affection* /əˈfekʃn/.
